lemma: describe work with a connected detail
displayForm: I work as a graphic designer, and I work from home most days.

ru.translation: Я работаю графическим дизайнером и большую часть дней работаю из дома.

examples.text: I work as a graphic designer, and I work from home most days.

npcReplyCorrect: That must be convenient. Do you have any brothers or sisters?

displayForm: I have one sister, and we often cook dinner together.

ru.translation: У меня есть сестра, и мы часто готовим ужин вместе.

examples.text: I have one sister, and we often cook dinner together.

npcReplyCorrect: That sounds nice. What do you like doing in your free time?

lemma: connect an interest with a related local detail
displayForm: I play tennis at weekends. I've lived here for three years, so I know a couple of good courts.

ru.translation: По выходным я играю в теннис. Я живу здесь уже три года, поэтому знаю пару хороших кортов.
ru.usageNote: I've lived here for three years is a fixed lexical chunk; Present Perfect is not taught as a target here.

examples.text: I play tennis at weekends. I've lived here for three years, so I know a couple of good courts.

npcReplyCorrect: Three years is a good while. Which courts do you like best?

lemma: introduce different job and family details
displayForm: I'm a primary-school teacher, and I share a flat with my cousin.

ru.translation: Я учитель начальной школы и снимаю квартиру вместе с двоюродной сестрой.

examples.text: I'm a primary-school teacher, and I share a flat with my cousin.

npcReplyCorrect: Primary school must be lively. What do you and your cousin do together?

displayForm: We cook together most evenings, and I go swimming on Sundays.

ru.translation: Мы готовим вместе почти каждый вечер, а по воскресеньям я хожу плавать.

examples.text: We cook together most evenings, and I go swimming on Sundays.

npcReplyCorrect: That sounds like a lovely routine. How long have you lived in this neighbourhood?

lemma: say how long you have lived somewhere
displayForm: I've lived here for six months, but I still don't know many cafés.

ru.translation: Я живу здесь шесть месяцев, но пока знаю мало кафе.
ru.usageNote: I've lived here for six months is a fixed lexical chunk; Present Perfect is not taught as a target here.

examples.text: I've lived here for six months, but I still don't know many cafés.

npcReplyCorrect: In that case, I can recommend a little place near the park.

lemma: answer how you know a mutual friend
displayForm: Alex and I know each other from the café near my office.

ru.translation: Мы с Алексом знаем друг друга по кафе рядом с моим офисом.

examples.text: Alex and I know each other from the café near my office.

npcReplyCorrect: Small world—Alex knows everyone around here! What do you do?

lemma: share work and ask a social question
displayForm: I work in a small design office. What about you?

ru.translation: Я работаю в небольшом дизайнерском бюро. А ты?

examples.text: I work in a small design office. What about you?

npcReplyCorrect: I'm an architect. I spend most of my day drawing plans.

lemma: show interest with a follow-up question
displayForm: That sounds interesting. What do you enjoy most about your work?

examples.text: That sounds interesting. What do you enjoy most about your work?

npcReplyCorrect: I like seeing a design take shape. What do you like doing outside work?

lemma: connect with someone through a shared activity
displayForm: Alex and I are in the same weekend running group. We usually get coffee after the run.

ru.translation: Мы с Алексом ходим в одну беговую группу по выходным.

examples.text: Alex and I are in the same weekend running group. We usually get coffee after the run.

npcReplyCorrect: That sounds fun. How do you know Maya?

displayForm: Maya and I are in the same English class. We sit together.

ru.translation: Мы с Майей ходим в одну группу английского языка. Мы сидим вместе.

examples.text: Maya and I are in the same English class. We sit together.

npcReplyCorrect: That makes sense—Maya is good at bringing people together.

lemma: change an item in an order
displayForm: Actually, could I change this to a tea instead?

ru.translation: Слушай, можно я заменю кофе на чай?

examples.text: Actually, could I change this to a tea instead?

npcReplyCorrect: Of course. I haven't made it yet. Hot or iced?

displayForm: Hot, please. Can I have it large?

examples.text: Hot, please. Can I have it large?

npcReplyCorrect: Sure—a large hot tea. I'll update the order before you pay.

lemma: change the quantity in an order
displayForm: Actually, can I make that two teas instead of one?

ru.translation: Можно я изменю заказ: вместо одного чая будет два?

examples.text: Actually, can I make that two teas instead of one?

npcReplyCorrect: No problem. Two teas—the card reader is ready when you are.

lemma: change an order after payment starts
displayForm: Sorry, I've just tapped my card. Could I change that to three teas instead?

ru.translation: Извините, я только что приложила карту. Можно изменить заказ на три чая?
ru.usageNote: I've just tapped my card is a fixed Present Perfect chunk; no Present Perfect target is introduced here.

examples.text: Sorry, I've just tapped my card. Could I change that to three teas instead?

npcReplyCorrect: That's fine. I can cancel that payment and update the order to three teas.

displayForm: I'd like to book a table for Friday evening, please.

examples.text: I'd like to book a table for Friday evening, please.

npcReplyCorrect: Certainly. How many people is the table for?

lemma: give the party size and ask about a booking time
displayForm: Two, please. Is seven thirty available?

ru.translation: На двоих, пожалуйста. Можно на половину восьмого?

examples.text: Two, please. Is seven thirty available?

npcReplyCorrect: It is. What name should I put on the booking?

lemma: give the name for a booking

examples.text: Anna, please. That's A-N-N-A.

npcReplyCorrect: Thank you, Anna. You're booked for two at seven thirty on Friday.

lemma: book a different day and party size
displayForm: I'd like to book a table for four on Saturday, please.

ru.translation: Я бы хотела забронировать столик на субботу на четверых.

examples.text: I'd like to book a table for four on Saturday, please.

npcReplyCorrect: Certainly. I can offer six thirty or eight. Which time works for you?

lemma: choose a time and give the booking name
displayForm: Eight is good. The booking is under Anna.

ru.translation: Восемь подойдёт. Бронь на имя Анна.

examples.text: Eight is good. The booking is under Anna.

npcReplyCorrect: Great, a table for four at eight on Saturday, under Anna.

lemma: ask to repeat booking information on a phone call
displayForm: Sorry, could you repeat the available times? I'm calling to book for Sunday, and the line cut out.

ru.translation: Извините, повторите, пожалуйста, свободное время? Я звоню забронировать столик на воскресенье, связь прервалась.
ru.usageNote: Could you repeat is a fixed polite clarification chunk; the exchange is explicitly phone-only.

examples.text: Sorry, could you repeat the available times? I'm calling to book for Sunday, and the line cut out.

npcReplyCorrect: Of course. I can offer six fifteen or eight. Which time works for you?

displayForm: Eight, please. I'd like a table for four, and the name is Anna.

ru.translation: На восемь, пожалуйста. Столик на четверых, имя Анна.

examples.text: Eight, please. I'd like a table for four, and the name is Anna.

npcReplyCorrect: All set, Anna: four people at eight on Sunday.

lemma: request a dairy-free change to a dish
displayForm: Yes, please. Could we have it without cream?

examples.text: Yes, please. Could we have it without cream?

lemma: increase a group order from two to four portions

examples.text: Could we have four bowls instead of two? And some bread for everyone, please.

displayForm: Sorry I'm late. I missed the bus, and the next one isn't for twenty minutes.

lemma: explain missing a meeting after going to the wrong building

examples.text: I'm sorry I'm late for the meeting. I went to the wrong building, so I missed it.

lemma: explain a personal delay that caused a missed train
displayForm: I'm sorry. I overslept because my alarm didn't ring, and we missed our early train.

examples.text: I'm sorry. I overslept because my alarm didn't ring, and we missed our early train.

npcReplyCorrect: Oh, that's a shame. The next train leaves at twelve thirty. Do you still want to go today?

lemma: ask how to change a delayed travel plan
displayForm: Yes, let's go later. What should we do now?

ru.translation: Да, давай поедем позже. Что нам теперь делать?
ru.usageNote: Let's go later is a fixed suggestion chunk; should is recycled to ask for advice.

examples.text: Yes, let's go later. What should we do now?

npcReplyCorrect: You should call the hotel and tell them we'll arrive later.
